tags.title: checkout
tags.name: Checkout
tags.description: The checkout page is where the user decides whether to go through with the order or not and in most cases this is when they make their decision. This means that you want to make sure that your checkout pages are optimized and in some cases even have a separate page from your landing pages.

tags.title: product-page
tags.name: Product Page
tags.description: A product page is a webpage on an e-commerce site that showcases the features of an item, provides information on pricing and availability, and allows customers to purchase the item.

tags.title: signin-signup
tags.name: Sign In/Sign Up
tags.description: Sign up and sign in pages are pages that a website or a web-based service may provide to allow a user to register an account or sign in with an existing account. A sign up page typically allows a new user to enter their email address and create a password.

tags.title: errors
tags.name: Error Pages
tags.description: Error pages are used when users request a web page that has not been found on the server. The typical error page contains useful information for the user, such as an error code and a link to search for possible solutions.

tags.title: section-titles
tags.name: Section Titles
tags.description: Section Title Styles help you create beautiful and professional headings and titles to make your website more unique and engaging,  build better websites with Section Titles because the right choice of heading styles can be the difference between a site that's clear.

categories.title: Marketing UI
categories.description: Website sections and components that are required to build landing page, website and promoting products. These are the most important components while you are creating business site. Must need to be present on your landing page, website and promotional products. The sections include about us, portfolio, contact us, services, features, CTA and more.

tags.title: features
tags.name: Features & Services
tags.description: Features and services components are the next step in convincing the customer to make a purchase. It provides them with information about your product and why it is unique. This section also helps to convince potential customers that you are credible and trustworthy.

tags.title: headers
tags.name: Headers
tags.description: Headers and hero areas are a key part of web design. They represent the first thing a visitor sees on your page. This is why it is important to make sure that they are as attractive as possible. The hero area is the section of a webpage that has the most important information. It is usually positioned at the top of the website and can be found above or below the header. The hero area is usually used to promote a product or service that may not be on sale for everyone, but it will only be available to those who are able to see this area.

tags.title: sliders
tags.name: Sliders
tags.description: Sliders are an important design element for websites. They help us to give the user a quick overview of what is on offer. A slider or scroller is typically a horizontal slider or scroller, typically found on the top of a website. It is usually used to showcase images, videos, and other content.

tags.title: pricing-tables
tags.name: Pricing Tables
tags.description: Pricing tables are a great way of presenting the customer with the various plans and prices for a product or service. They present information in an easy-to-read and quick-to-process format and also serve as a comparison tool. The table displays what is available, how much it costs, and what benefits come with each plan, making it easier for customers to decide which one is right for them.

tags.title: portfolios
tags.name: Portfolios
tags.description: The portfolio section is a representation of pas works and projects. It provides a glimpse into their past and shows potential clients where they have been and what their strengths are, portfolio is a snapshot of your work to show employers or clients what you can do.

tags.title: about
tags.name: About
tags.description: The About Us Page is the heart of any website. It’s your chance to introduce your company or brand to potential customers or visitors in a captivating way. Your About Us Page needs to convince people that they should give your business a chance. So it’s important to make sure you get it right!

tags.title: teams
tags.name: Teams
tags.description: A team section of a website is important to highlight the team that is behind the project. It helps customers connect with the people who are involved in the project or product.  The team section can help customers see that there is more to the website than just their product. A good example of this is how Amazon does it on their homepage - they present their product, Alexa, as a part of Amazon.

tags.title: clients
tags.name: Clients
tags.description: Clients are the backbone of any content marketing strategy, showing your existing customer and client logos will represent your site or business as trustworthy to your potential customers and convert.

tags.title: testimonials
tags.name: Testimonials
tags.description: Testimonials are a great way for potential customers to get a feel for the company. They show that real people are using the products and services of the company. testimonials can increase conversions by up to 80%  and a great way to show customers that you have other satisfied customers.

tags.title: videos
tags.name: Videos
tags.description: Video is a representation of what your product is and what you want customers to feel. It brings customers on the journey of discovering the brand, company, and product. Videos are a great way to represent your company's culture or background in a way that is both engaging and informative. Videos are also great for telling your company's story, introducing new products, or explaining how-to tutorials.

tags.title: call-to-actions
tags.name: Call to Actions
tags.description: A call to action (CTA) is an instruction to the user, asking them to take a concrete action. Call-to-action buttons are an easy way to encourage visitors to take a specific action, such as buying a product, signing up for a newsletter, or reading an article.

tags.title: coming-soon
tags.name: Coming Soon Pages
tags.description: Coming soon pages are designed to create anticipation and excitement for the launch of a product or website. A coming soon page is a web page on a website that is not yet available to the public, but will be made available in the near future.

tags.title: toggles
tags.name: Toggle Buttons
tags.description: Bootstrap toggle buttons are a type of button that stays hidden until you hover over it. Used for save/delete, active/deactivate, upvote/downvote, and many other purposes.
